high_level_description: The image depicts a modern, minimalist living room setting featuring a set of wooden furniture. The main piece is a sofa with a simple, geometric design, constructed from light-colored wood. The sofa has a rectangular frame with clean lines and a low backrest. It is upholstered with a dark brown fabric that appears to be a textured material, possibly linen or a similar fabric. Two matching armchairs are positioned on either side of the sofa, each with a similar design and upholstery. In front of the sofa, there is a small wooden coffee table with a similar finish and style as the sofa.
